description: This Java class defines a REST controller for handling tenders in the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Monitoring System. It provides in-memory stubbed endpoints to list all tenders and to retrieve a specific tender by ID.

classes.name: TendersController
classes.description: REST controller providing read-only endpoints for tenders with in-memory data storage.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all tenders. Returns the list of hardcoded tenders.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for a specific tender by ID. Returns the tender if found, otherwise a 404 response.
